interpretationReason: Below the minimums of CORPUS_PLAN section 4. Synthetic journal: 7 full-text papers, fewer than 150; Synthetic journal: 2024–2025 has 7 (fewer than 20 per bucket); Synthetic control: 7 full-text papers, fewer than 150; Synthetic control: 2024–2025 has 7 (fewer than 20 per bucket).
methodNotes: Values are per paper: body blocks only, publisher boilerplate (competing interests, CRediT, data availability, acknowledgements, funding, front matter), references and title removed; one paper model per member.
Profiled papers are build members that were retrieved, read in full text and have a paper on this device; held-out members are never profiled.

Continuous features compare corpora with Cohen's d (pooled SD); prevalence features with the difference in proportions. The 95% CI is a percentile bootstrap of that same effect over 2000 resamples of whole papers, independently within each corpus, seeded from the profile seed.
p values are two-sided Mann–Whitney U (normal approximation, tie and continuity corrected). q values are Benjamini–Hochberg over every registry feature with a p value; phrases form a separate family.
A feature is distinctive when q < 0.05 and |d| ≥ 0.2 or |difference in proportions| ≥ 0.1.

Machine-label features (stance, rhetoric, claim types) count a paper only when its latest run covers every body section except appendices; machineShare is the share of counted labels no person has confirmed.

Phrases: document frequency (papers using the phrase, counted once per paper) compared by G² (1 df) and Log Ratio; tested only when used by at least 5% of target papers and at least 5 papers (owner decision 5); only phrases the target uses more are listed, top 50 by G² with q < 0.05; evidence excerpts are at most 300 characters (decision 6).
Year buckets are 2 years wide from the earliest protocol year (or paper year when the protocol names none); sizes and buckets count full-text members, held-out ones included.
Not yet done: author-cluster bootstrap and leaving each control journal out.
